BACKLOG_GAP: Some messages may be missing here
BADGE_CHANNEL_DESCRIPTION: Hype train, Bits, and sub-gifter badges.
BADGE_VANITY_DESCRIPTION: Twitch global, partner, and other miscellaneous badges.
CHAT_MESSAGE_HELD: Your message is with the mods for review.
COMMAND_BAN: Permanently ban a user from chat
COMMAND_CLIP: Create a clip of the stream
COMMAND_CLIP_FAILED: Failed to create clip (stream may be offline)
COMMAND_COLOR: Change your display color in chat
COMMAND_FOLLOWAGE: Show how long you've followed this channel
COMMAND_ME: Send a message as an action
COMMAND_UNIQUECHAT: Require each message to be unique
COMMAND_UPTIME: Show how long the stream has been live
COMMAND_WARN: Warn a user without timing them out
ERROR_IO: Something went wrong on this device
EVENT_CHAT_CLEARED: Chat has been cleared by a moderator.
EVENT_TYPE_ANNOUNCEMENT_DESCRIPTION: Highlighted announcements from the broadcaster or mods.
EVENT_TYPE_BITS_BADGE_TIER_DESCRIPTION: When a viewer earns a new Bits badge tier.
EVENT_TYPE_CHARITY_DONATION_DESCRIPTION: Donations made through the channel's charity campaign.
EVENT_TYPE_FOLLOW_DESCRIPTION: When a user follows the channel (mods only).
EVENT_TYPE_MODERATION_DESCRIPTION: Bans, timeouts, deletions and mode changes by mods.
EVENT_TYPE_RAID_DESCRIPTION: Incoming raids and unraids on the channel.
EVENT_TYPE_SHOUTOUT_DESCRIPTION: Shoutouts created by the broadcaster or mods.
EVENT_TYPE_SUB_DESCRIPTION: New subs, resubs, gifts, and Prime upgrades.
SETTINGS_ADVANCED_ALWAYS_ON_TOP_DESCRIPT: Keep the window above other applications.
SETTINGS_ADVANCED_AUTOSTART_DESCRIPTION: Open Deatch when you sign in to Windows.
SETTINGS_ADVANCED_DEVELOPER_MODE_DESCRIP: Extra technical details and copy options in menus.
SETTINGS_ADVANCED_DISCORD_PRESENCE_DESCR: Show the channel you're watching on Discord. Needs Discord running.
SETTINGS_ADVANCED_HARDWARE_ACCELERATION_: {enabled, select, true {Turn on hardware acceleration?} other {Turn off hardware acceleration?}}
Render with the GPU. Turn off if the window flickers or shows artifacts. Changing this restarts Deatch.
SETTINGS_ADVANCED_RESTART_DESCRIPTION: Deatch will quit and relaunch to apply the change.
SETTINGS_ADVANCED_SHOW_LOGS_DESCRIPTION: Show technical log messages as pop-ups.
SETTINGS_APPEARANCE_ACCENT_DESCRIPTION: The colour of selected things, buttons, and messages that mention you.
SETTINGS_APPEARANCE_AVATARS_DESCRIPTION: Show chatters' Twitch pictures in the spacious layout. Off uses a generated picture for everyone.
SETTINGS_APPEARANCE_CHANNEL_SPACING_DESC: How much room each channel takes in the list on the left.
SETTINGS_APPEARANCE_COPYPASTA_DESCRIPTIO: Add a button to each message that copies it into your message box.
SETTINGS_APPEARANCE_DELETED_DESCRIPTION: Keep deleted messages readable, dimmed, instead of hiding what they said.
SETTINGS_APPEARANCE_DISPLAY_NAMES_DESCRI: Show names with the capitals chatters picked, like MayaOnAir instead of mayaonair.
SETTINGS_APPEARANCE_FONT_SIZE_DESCRIPTIO: You can also hold Alt and scroll over the chat.
SETTINGS_APPEARANCE_LEDE: How Deatch looks. Changes show straight away.
SETTINGS_APPEARANCE_MESSAGE_LAYOUT_DESCR: Default fits the most chat on screen. Spacious groups each chatter's messages under their name and picture. Alt+D switches.
SETTINGS_APPEARANCE_NAME_COLOR_DESCRIPTI: Give every name the same colour. Reset to use each chatter's own colour.
SETTINGS_APPEARANCE_THEME_DESCRIPTION: Match Windows, or pick dark or light.
SETTINGS_APPEARANCE_TIMESTAMPS_DESCRIPTI: Show the time next to each message. The spacious layout always shows it.
SETTINGS_APPEARANCE_ZOOM_DESCRIPTION: Make everything bigger or smaller. Ctrl + and Ctrl − also work, Ctrl 0 resets.
SETTINGS_KEYBOARD_CLOSE_PANEL: Close the open overlay, or leave Settings and Explore
SETTINGS_KEYBOARD_LEDE: Every action has a key. Rebinding lands in a later release.
SETTINGS_KEYBOARD_LINK_CLOSE_TAB: Link: close the channel's browser tab
SETTINGS_KEYBOARD_LINK_OPEN_TAB: Link: open the channel's browser tab when it has none
SETTINGS_KEYBOARD_TOGGLE_DENSITY: Switch between default and spacious chat
SETTINGS_LINK_ATTACK_DESCRIPTION: How fast it reacts when a stream gets louder.
SETTINGS_LINK_COMPRESSOR_DESCRIPTION: Evens out every Twitch tab: quiet streams come up, loud moments come down, and nothing clips. Set a channel's own tab volume by right-clicking it in the rail.
SETTINGS_LINK_GAIN_DESCRIPTION: Trims the level after compression. The compressor already adds some on its own as it works.
SETTINGS_LINK_LEDE: How Deatch works with the Twitch tabs in your browser.
SETTINGS_LINK_RATIO_DESCRIPTION: How firmly it compresses above the threshold.
SETTINGS_LINK_RELEASE_DESCRIPTION: How fast it lets go once it's quieter again.
SETTINGS_LINK_UPDATE_EXTENSION: Update the Deatch Link extension in your browser to use the compressor and channel volumes.
SETTINGS_MODERATION_HIDE_ACTIONS_DESCRIP: Hide the ban, timeout, and delete buttons everywhere.
SETTINGS_MODERATION_LEDE: Tools for channels you own or moderate.
SETTINGS_MODERATION_SHOUTOUT_RAIDERS_DES: Automatically shout out anyone who raids a channel you own or moderate.
SETTINGS_NOTIFICATIONS_KEYWORDS_DESCRIPT: Messages with these words light up like mentions and land in your inbox. Use * for part of a word: drop* matches drops and dropped.
SETTINGS_NOTIFICATIONS_LEDE: How Deatch gets your attention when something needs it.
SETTINGS_NOTIFICATIONS_MENTION_SOUND_DES: Play a sound when someone mentions you or uses one of your keywords.
SETTINGS_TRIGGERS_LEDE: Send or reply automatically when a message in your own channel matches a phrase. Changes apply when you save.
SETTINGS_TRIGGERS_MATCH_PLACEHOLDER: Phrases to match, one per line. Use * as a wildcard, e.g. hi*
SETTINGS_TRIGGERS_REQUIRED: Name, phrase and response are required
